sentences.en: We have a wide choice of fruits at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 超市里水果种类很丰富。

sentences.en: A wide leather belt would look good with that dress.
sentences.zh: 那条皮带如果宽度合适的话会和那件裙子很搭。

sentences.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
sentences.zh: 婚前要睁大眼睛，婚后可以适当放松警惕。

senses.zh: 宽的，广阔的；张大的；远离目标的；广泛的ad
